title: Implement Robust Error Handling Mechanism
description: This feature will provide a centralized error handling system, allowing for better logging and error reporting, which will improve the overall stability and reliability of the yantraverse framework. It will handle errors in a more efficient and informative way, making it easier to diagnose and fix issues. This will also enhance the developer experience by providing more detailed error messages
testCases: Test error handling for route not found
Test error handling for server errors
acceptance: Error handling mechanism should log errors with relevant details, provide informative error messages to users, and not crash the server on error occurrence
reason: Robust error handling is crucial for a production-ready framework like yantraverse, as it directly impacts the user experience and overall system reliability
